rateLimiting.INSTANCE_LOCAL_RATE_LIMIT: per-IP sliding window on 4 proxies (TTS/STT 30, chat 40, online 20 /min·IP)
rateLimiting.DISTRIBUTED_RATE_LIMIT: NOT_PROVISIONED — requires shared KV (Vercel KV/Upstash) = OWNER_INFRA_DECISION
rateLimiting.clientKey: first x-forwarded-for hop used ONLY as an ephemeral in-memory map key; never persisted or written to logs/evidence
rateLimiting.residualAbuseRisk: a distributed flood across many instances/IPs is not fully bounded per-instance; per-request caps + per-IP + per-instance circuit reduce single-source amplification
rateLimiting.recommendation: provision a shared-KV distributed limiter if abuse is observed; until then the shipped in-memory limits + tightened caps are the machine-closable protection

rollbackSafety: only P0/P1-clean + secret-clean target; exposed 0.5.0 production is NOT acceptable rollback
